sloka: उवाच नर शार्दूलम् अंबरीषम् इदम् वचः ।अविक्रेयम् सुतम् ज्येष्ठम् भगवान् आह भार्गवः ॥१-६१-१७॥
transliteration: uvāca nara śārdūlam aṁbarīṣam idam vacaḥ ।avikreyam sutam jyeṣṭham bhagavān āha bhārgavaḥ ॥1-61-17॥

translations.english: Venerable descendant of the Bhrugus (sage Richika) said that the eldest son cannot be sold. "O King the youngest son, Sunaka, is my beloved son. You know, O King for that reason I will not give my yougest son".
